description: Hand reading by meaning over large text (logs, archives, long documents, web pages) to a cheap model; quotes and line refs come back checked against the source. For exact values, structure or files under ~30 KB use mode grep ($0) or your own file tools. Each call is a paid job within daily_budget_usd; full result via eyes_result.

async.description: Return the result id at once; poll eyes_result

dry_run.description: Build and store the request, do not call the model

export_to.description: Also copy the result here (inside write_roots)

files.description: Absolute paths or globs inside read roots, or http(s) URLs (fetched by the server). Range "#L100-L400" only with a single file

max_tokens.description: Output cap per chunk; default extract 16000, schema 8000, draft/edits 4096

mode.description: extract: verbatim lines; draft: markdown with refs; edits: JSON line edits (never applied); grep: matches, no model; schema: JSON fields with refs

model.description: Model alias from the settings; "auto" (the models the server picked) when the settings name none; default per mode

overwrite.description: Replace an earlier export of this server

schema.description: mode schema: {"field": "number — description", "list": [{...}]}; max 60 fields, depth 4

task.description: What to look for or write (optional for grep and schema). Masked like file content.

time.description: Keep log lines whose timestamp is in the window

tz.description: IANA zone for stamps without offset

name: eyes_run
title: Run cheap reading job
